# Cloud Computing Associates

> Cloud Computing Associates is a national AI consulting firm. We help leadership
> teams turn artificial intelligence into measurable business results, designing,
> building and operating production systems on Google Cloud.

## Who we are

Founded in 2017, we are a virtual firm based in Portland, Oregon, serving clients
nationwide, remote and on-site. We work alongside your teams from strategy through
deployment, transfer the expertise to your engineers, and stay accountable for the
results.

## What we do

- AI agents that take on operational work
- Assistants grounded in your organization's own knowledge
- Automated workflows
- Custom models trained on your data
- Google Cloud architecture, development, testing and delivery

## Services

- Analysis: requirements elicitation, product development and management, timeline projections
- Consulting: just-in-time knowledge transfer and senior management presentations
- Architecture & Design: platforms, apps, AI custom models and agents
- Development: prototype to production-ready code
- Testing: AI model behavior, end-to-end agentic system, cloud and UI/API testing
- Compliance: data privacy (PI/HIPAA), AI-specific regulatory, industry and business requirements
